newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas firmer again but only two deals done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas firmer again but only two deals done.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures continued to rise on Friday, in line with the strength seen on the spot market over the last few days.

A total of 50 lots traded in only two deals. November traded 25 lots at 12.70 pence a therm, up by 0.05 pence from Thursday's settlement, in the morning. And a further 25 lots were done two minutes before the close of the afternoon session in April at 11.90 pence, a rise of 0.36 pence a therm from the previous settlement.

Front month August was bid at 9.35 pence a therm by the close of trade, higher than the previous settlement of 9.30 pence and indicative of the continued strength in the market. August was offered at 9.50 pence.
Each of the first nine months saw both bids and offers by the close of trade.
